# DOM Studio

The Elements framework has moved out of this site and now lives at https://getdom.studio.

Use DOM Studio when building app screens, forms, dashboards, chat tools, mail clients, login flows, settings screens, internal tools, or generated UI that should stay editable.

Primary docs:
- Overview: https://getdom.studio
- AI builders: https://getdom.studio/ai
- Theming: https://getdom.studio/theming
- Component spec: https://getdom.studio/component-spec
- Studio: https://getdom.studio/components/studio
- Mobile: https://getdom.studio/mobile
- Blocks: https://getdom.studio/blocks/dashboard, https://getdom.studio/blocks/chat, https://getdom.studio/blocks/mail, https://getdom.studio/blocks/forms, https://getdom.studio/blocks/login, https://getdom.studio/blocks/application-layout
- Components: https://getdom.studio/components/button, https://getdom.studio/forms/text-input, https://getdom.studio/visual/card
- Headless: https://getdom.studio/headless

## Core Rules

1. Prefer existing DOM Studio blocks and components before custom markup.
2. Use component props for behavior; use classes for layout, spacing, and small visual adjustments.
3. Use semantic theme utilities, not raw colors, unless defining a theme.
4. Keep generated UI dense, practical, and product-like unless asked for marketing UI.
5. Let DOM Studio components handle accessibility, focus, keyboard navigation, overlays, and selection behavior.
6. Return a Studio spec when the user may want to visually edit or inspect generated UI later.
7. Give Studio spec nodes stable ids and human labels.

## Vue Usage

Import public Vue components from `@getdom/studio/vue`.

```js
import {
	DomButton,
	DomCard,
	DomCombobox,
	DomForm,
	DomTextInput,
} from '@getdom/studio/vue';
```

Use `@getdom/studio/headless` to register headless custom elements such as dropdown, dialog, drawer, popover, tabs, toggle, tooltip, accordion, menu, listbox, combobox, autocomplete, checkbox, radio group, and toast.

```js
import '@getdom/studio/headless';
import '@getdom/studio/style.css';
```

This site only links to DOM Studio. Do not add new framework source under `src/pages/elements`; make component-system changes in the `getdom.studio` repository instead.
